stages.name: Schema Validation
stages.failure: Any required artifact fails its canonical JSON Schema.

stages.name: Metadata Validation
stages.failure: Required metadata missing, inconsistent, or domain_id unknown.

stages.name: Dependency Validation
stages.failure: Missing required dependency, cycle, conflict, or list mismatch.

stages.name: Integrity Validation
stages.failure: Declared file missing, folder/id mismatch, or duplicate identifier.

stages.name: Compatibility Validation
stages.failure: Active versions or language/school outside declared compatibility.

stages.name: Quality Validation
stages.failure: Achieved quality level below gate requirement.

stages.name: Golden Dataset Validation
stages.failure: Any golden test fails. Golden/snapshot/expected files must not be edited.

stages.name: Release Validation
stages.failure: Incomplete release metadata, null checksum, or unmet immutability/dependency rules.
